bio.text: Jonny Larsen is the Democratic nominee for Utah's 4th Congressional District in 2026, facing Republican Rep. Mike Kennedy.
The Salt Lake Tribune describes him as a U.S. Marine Corps combat veteran who calls himself a "Blue Dog Democrat."

sources.title: U.S. Rep. Mike Kennedy faces Steven Burt, Jonny Larsen and Taylor Wright in Utah's 2026 Congressional District 4 race
